entry.price_rule: the shortest-dated forward observed in the chain, used as a spot proxy
entry.fill_rule: pay the forward plus the future taker fee

costs.future_taker_fee: 0.05% of notional, paid once at entry

marking.schedule: once per day at the scheduled run
marking.equity_definition: cash plus position value; starts at zero, so equity is cumulative profit and loss in USD

notes: Context, not a benchmark. A delta-hedged volatility strategy is not trying to beat long BTC, and presenting them as competitors would be dishonest. This line exists so a reader can see what the market did over the same window.
